nodes.label: HealthReport
nodes.description: Domain type for an AI-generated health report: id, periodStart, periodEnd, generatedAt, summaryStats, correlations, aiReportText, model

nodes.label: useHealthReports
nodes.description: Standalone data hook (not part of TrackingContext boot load): fetches reports on mount via fetchHealthReports, exposes generateReport()/refresh(); own loading + generating busy flags; surfaces failures via Alert.alert

nodes.label: HealthReportGenerator
nodes.description: Presentational: 7/30/90-day ReportPeriod selector (own local state, separate from Stats screen's 7/30 Period) + Generate button; calls onGenerate(periodStart, periodEnd) computed via getPeriodDateRange

nodes.label: HealthReportsList
nodes.description: Presentational: renders past HealthReport cards -- aiReportText plus formatted correlation lines; reads correlations defensively (jsonb, loosely typed) and shows insufficient-data copy per report when malformed/empty

nodes.label: lib/insightsEngine.ts
nodes.description: Deterministic, dependency-free stats/correlation layer shared verbatim between the client (Stats screen) and the generate-health-report Edge Function (Deno). Computes daily aggregates (calories, water, macros, Bristol distribution) and 2x2-contingency-table trigger/outcome correlations (lift ratio) via computeCorrelations. AI never computes correlations, only narrates this output. Relative imports use explicit .ts extensions for Deno resolution.

nodes.label: lib/ingredientTags.ts
nodes.description: Static regex-based ingredient-name to IngredientTag lookup (dairy, gluten, caffeine, alcohol, spicy, fried, high_fat, high_fodmap, artificial_sweetener, citrus). Dependency-free so it loads unmodified under Deno. Tags derived on the fly at report-generation time -- no DB schema change.

nodes.label: supabase/functions/generate-health-report
nodes.description: Deno Edge Function, RLS-scoped via withSupabase({auth:'user'}), no service-role key. Validates request -> rate-limits (max 5/24h) -> fetches food/water (2-day lookback buffer)/bowel entries for the period -> computes summaryStats/correlations via insightsEngine -> sends only that compact JSON to Gemini for narration -> inserts into health_reports -> returns report. Enforces a mandatory doctor call-out whenever hasBlood is true regardless of model compliance.

nodes.label: generate-health-report/gemini.ts
nodes.description: Gemini 2.5 Flash text-generation call for the report narrative. Reads GEMINI_API_KEY via Deno.env.get (Edge Function secret, never EXPO_PUBLIC_*). Prompt embeds mandatory safety framing (not medical advice, correlation != causation, required doctor call-out when blood present) and only the pre-computed stats/correlations JSON -- never raw entry logs.

nodes.label: generate-health-report/db.ts
nodes.description: Data-fetching + row-mapping for the Edge Function: fetchFoodEntries/fetchWaterEntries/fetchBowelEntries (minimal fields insightsEngine needs, no photo/full-nutrition mapping) and countRecentReports for the rate limit.

nodes.label: DB: health_reports
nodes.description: Supabase table (migration 009): id, user_id, period_start, period_end, generated_at, summary_stats (jsonb), correlations (jsonb), ai_report_text, model. RLS: select/insert/delete scoped to auth.uid(), no update policy (immutable snapshot).

nodes.label: Pattern: Standalone data hook
nodes.description: Opt-in/infrequently-visited data lives in its own hook with its own useState/useEffect fetch-on-mount, not folded into TrackingContext's boot-time Promise.all -- keeps the context shape stable. Pattern: loading (fetch-on-mount) + a separate generating/submitting busy flag guarded at the top of the action, try/catch/finally with Alert.alert on failure. Reference implementation: useHealthReports.

nodes.label: Pattern: AI/deterministic compute boundary
nodes.description: Hard rule for any server-side compute pattern: deterministic code (insightsEngine) computes all aggregates/correlation math; the LLM only ever receives the compact computed JSON to narrate, never raw entry rows. Governs generate-health-report and any future sleep/activity correlation work.

nodes.label: Pattern: Cross-runtime shared module
nodes.description: Logic that must run identically on client and Deno Edge Function belongs in a plain, dependency-free lib/*.ts file -- no RN or Deno-specific APIs, unit-testable under plain Jest. Relative imports must use explicit .ts extensions for Deno module resolution (Metro/tsc infer extensions, Deno does not). tsconfig.json needs allowImportingTsExtensions:true; supabase/functions stays excluded from tsc (its own Deno LSP typecheck).
